description: This file defines a configured binding consumer for 'acp' type, including functions to resolve defaults, build specifications, and create target factories for ACP bindings, along with exporting the consumer object.

methods.name: resolveAgentRuntimeAcpDefaults
methods.description: Resolves default ACP runtime settings for a given agent ID from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBindingWorkspaceCwd
methods.description: Determines the workspace directory for a given agent ID based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: buildConfiguredAcpSpec
methods.description: Builds a configuration object for an ACP binding specification.

methods.name: buildAcpTargetFactory
methods.description: Creates a target factory for ACP bindings, supporting the 'acp' type and generating binding records.
